exposure: Home environment factors (carpet or floor bedding, new furniture, pet keeping, passive smoking, mould or hygroma)
cohort: 8153 preschool children in Urumqi, Xinjiang, China
finding: Several factors, including caesarean section, family history of asthma, certain home environment characteristics, and passive smoking, were associated with an increased risk of wheeze and asthma in preschool children.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a risk factor for both wheeze and asthma in this study.
